signal_sources: Per-pair noise_prior sigma under the identical GT pipeline: pair0 3.83, pair1 1.11, pair2 0.49 (R0 support_verification target sigma; verify_signals also reported noise:sigma mismatch 100% on pair2). Pairs1/2 at or below the SKILL sigma<2 NO_NOISE threshold -> noise presence is not consistent across support pairs.

Peeled residual structure: R0 noise_6step_check spatial_corr=0.9869 (blur_gaussian:3+saturate_strengthen_HSV:4 peel); R1 peeled_noise_check re-run with sat3 peel gives spatial_corr=0.9864, residual_std=10.2. spatial_corr >0.15 by ~6x means the peeled residual is spatially correlated structure (clip/blur mismatch), not noise.
SKILL noise-DT reliability: under the confirmed noise->blur order, noise-type classification is 54.7% (~random) per full_analysis signal_reliability; R0 itself marked the noise step UNCERTAIN.

Residual intensity dependence: residual_intensity_corr=0.864 on the raw pair0 residual (R1 full_analysis) -> intensity-dependent deterministic transform (HSV S clamp), matching saturate_strengthen rather than additive noise.
R0 final_decision's own note: simulated sat4 over-darkened pairs1/2 by ~5 gray levels, 'consistent with severity slightly above truth'; R0 only tested sat5 upward, never sat3 downward.
HSV saturation severity scale [3,6,12,20,64] for sev1-5 (x_distortion/saturate.py): sev3 (12x) vs sev4 (20x) differ only on low-saturation pixels, so sev3 is a physically plausible untested boundary.

Noise injection cost: replacing the noise step with deterministic-only reduced the simulation error by +1.24/+1.15/+0.93 dB on pairs 0/1/2; the extra RMS from speckle:3 (~6/10/10 gray levels) exceeds the measured target sigma (~3.8/1.1/0.5), i.e., the simulated noise is mis-scaled under the noise->blur order.
verify_signals variance_ratio normalizer artifact: pair2 |vr_t-1|=0.0177 gives diff_pct=111% for absolute 0.9626 vs 0.9823; not a valid rejection signal (recorded as boundary/threshold pathology).
reason: Four signal re-interpretations point the same way: (1) the R0 noise step is unsupported (inconsistent per-pair sigma, structured peel residual, 54.7% undiagnosable type, no PSNR benefit anywhere); (2) R0 bracketed saturation severity only upward and its own mean-shift analysis suspected over-darkening, so the untested sat3 was evaluated; (3) blur_gaussian:3 is confirmed as the PSNR-bracket peak over {2,3,4,5}; (4) compression remains absent on all 3 pairs. The resulting deterministic pipeline blur_gaussian:3 -> saturate_strengthen_HSV:3 improves the 3-pair simulation PSNR over the R0 pipeline by +1.46/+2.15/+2.20 dB (mean +1.94), clearing the +2 dB CHANGE bar on the majority of support pairs. R0 pipeline is retained as the fallback alternative; R1 verdict stays UNCERTAIN because no deterministic candidate exceeds 40 dB and the sat3 choice is a severity-level judgment.
